decisions.reason: As a flagship track-system adapter aligned with the firm's modular premium-lighting direction, it likely has low carrying cost and ecosystem value, so management would keep the option open absent clear evidence of failure.

As a standalone LED luminaire without later visible prominence, it has had enough time to reveal its market value, and management would likely free resources for stronger products and newer options if results were only middling.

A home-automation server box brings higher ongoing support, compatibility, and obsolescence risk than a conventional luminaire, so after several years the firm would likely abandon it unless it had clearly become a valuable platform.

Because it was launched as a luminaire family with its own page, it seems to have broader assortment and brand potential, making it worth retaining while it still supports the firm's premium interior-lighting portfolio.
